convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'trend_arrows' and external library TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management and money management. Custom indicator buffers require reverse-engineering or porting the indicator source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/Close functions with complex margin mode logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total
derived_values.used_by: BarsCalculated check to ensure indicator has enough data

other_exits: Up arrow signal triggers close of existing sell positions if SellPosClose is enabled
Down arrow signal triggers close of existing buy positions if BuyPosClose is enabled

Secondary confirmation: if both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose are enabled and trend_arrows buffer 0 (primary up) shows non-empty value on signal bar, additional buy close signal generated from down arrow

Secondary confirmation: if both SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are enabled and trend_arrows buffer 1 (primary down) shows non-empty value on signal bar, additional sell close signal generated from up arrow

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode selects sizing mode: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus floating loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus floating loss. Positive MM value=fraction, fixed lot when LOT mode selected.

custom_logic_notes: EA uses 4 buffers from trend_arrows custom indicator: buffer 0=primary up arrows, buffer 1=primary down arrows, buffer 2=secondary up arrows (entry signal), buffer 3=secondary down arrows (entry signal). When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. The Recount flag causes re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit for cleanup. BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen receive SignalTime which may be used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh to avoid duplicate entries on same bar. The secondary buffer check (buffers 0 and 1) adds an extra close-confirmation layer when both open and close flags are enabled for same direction.
python_conversion_notes: Must port trend_arrows custom indicator logic (source not available here, requires the .mq5 indicator file). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory) must be reimplemented - the margin mode logic (5 modes) and position open/close with signal time deduplication are the most complex parts. SL/TP are passed as integer pips to TradeAlgorithms which likely converts to price internally - verify whether pip-to-price conversion accounts for 5-digit brokers. SignalBar=1 default means signals are read from the previous completed bar (index 1), making this a next-bar-open execution model.
